portion_doctrine: AI Integration via Cloud-to-Dirt Knowledge: Integrate AI into existing business functions without advertising the tech. Core insight: business converts attention to profit; AI is a tool like the internet. Do NOT become an AI business. Own the full stack (strategy to API-plumbing). Fix the sales process BEFORE automating it. Pattern recognition, not magic. Proof required in B2B, visual OK in B2C.
operating_rules: Do not become an AI business; integrate AI into existing business model for better/faster/cheaper/less-risky outcomes
Own cloud-to-dirt knowledge (strategy + people + communication + API-plumbing) - do not delegate to tech specialists
Do not automate broken processes; fix the process first (apples-to-apples: train AI same way you trained humans)
Human psychology and persuasion rules do not change with AI; still apply the same techniques
Do not advertise AI use; customers care only about speed, cost, quality, and risk reduction
Find one daily workflow bottleneck and fully dedicate time to automate it soup-to-nuts (beginning to end)
Automation yields time for higher-value work, not time to do nothing
Intuition and gut feeling are learned pattern recognition; treat them as such for AI training
B2B requires proof (personal achievements/track record); faceless AI avatars fail in B2B
B2C is more forgiving of AI avatars if visually compelling; psychology still applies but lower-barrier entry
tools: Base44 - no-code AI builder for apps, SaaS, websites
Telegram BotFather - free bot creation and instant distribution (zero friction)
Calendar + transcription bots - extract interesting moments for content ideation
Trend research overlay - identify formats, hooks, visual hooks
Dynamic personalization bots - business-specific images and text generation
Static image templates - convert community wins to high-converting ad creatives
prompts: Wedding Planner AI: 'Act as an experienced wedding planner in the US with strong attention to detail. Be friendly, calm, and highly organized. Ask key questions first: budget, guest count, location, style. Then provide structured recommendations including venues, themes, and vendors. Keep responses clear, practical, and easy to follow. Focus on reducing stress and helping users make confident decisions.'

Baby Activity Generator input setup: 'Create user input fields for the app: (1) baby age as number input or dropdown (0-3 months, 3-6 months, 6-12 months, 1-2 years), (2) activity preference options (indoor/outdoor), (3) schedule options (morning/afternoon/full day). Make inputs simple, clear, and easy for parents to select. Ensure inputs guide AI to generate relevant and age-appropriate daily activities.'

Baby Activity Generator output: 'Generate simple baby activities that are short, clear, and easy to follow. Use the user's inputs to suggest age-appropriate activities. Include a small database of activity ideas grouped by age ranges and select the most relevant ones based on the baby's age, preferences, and schedule.'

Content ideation from calendar/transcription: 'Extract interesting situations or decisions from the past week. Identify the top 5 most interesting moments. Turn each into a document. Filter for true stories and narratives (epic moments).' [Avoids made-up content; relies on real proof]
gates: 18-month saturation window: AI business space will crowd; speed to market is now
Proof requirement in B2B: AI avatar without track record = GPT words, fails to convert
Process health check: do not deploy AI to broken sales motions or workflows
Training parity: AI must receive same investment (SOPs, data, iteration cycles) as human hire
content_ideas: Wedding Planner AI as lead-gen machine (venue commissions + photographer + caterer + decorator commissions, featured placement fees)
Baby Activity Generator as daily-use retention engine ($5/month subscription, affiliate products, premium features lock, brand partnerships)
AI SDR (sales development rep) matching human team performance in marketing outreach
Automated book-launch support system: 5 AI agents handling 120K support tickets, 90% resolved without human touch
Self-licking ice cream cone: daily content → auto-CTAs → ad campaigns launching daily with yesterday's content
Community wins automation: pull from community database → render into 6 high-converting visual templates → run as ads to premium tier
Interview-to-content: calendar + transcription bots → extract moments → ideate 10 content hooks → human picks best
Dynamic personalization at scale: automated voice notes, business-specific images, Instagram DM distribution via AI
Legal team multiplier: 1 general counsel + AI agents for contract review, cease-and-desist, first response, second response workflows
weird_gold: Cloud-to-dirt knowledge = vertical integration of knowledge from strategy to API-plumbing; this is the leverage multiplier (most founders delegate, missing the design opportunity)
Pattern recognition reframe: removes romanticism from specialized knowledge; makes it clear that if you can describe the pattern, a bot can execute it
Apples-to-apples comparison: most businesses fail AI because they compare 6-month-old half-trained AI to a 6-year-trained human; metrics are dishonest
Proof = the moat in B2B AI: AI avatars without founder track record will not convert; requires backing by real achievement
Self-licking ice cream cone model: content creation → auto-CTA → auto-ad → yesterday's content funds today's creation (automation flywheel)
18-month window claim: aggressive urgency signal; implies first-mover advantage in AI app space is closing, not opening
contradictions: Don't advertise AI use, yet this entire sales pitch is selling AI business models (implicit: show results, never show methodology)
Intuition/gut feeling is valuable, yet it's just pattern recognition (tension between art and science; both needed)
Fix processes first, yet the promise is 'no coding required' and 'build in minutes' (implies process is standardizable, contradicts idea that process design is the hard part)
